title: Isolated installer staging and API-aware packaging
summary: Separated installer rehearsal from production outputs and bound internal tooling to reviewed API contracts.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2026-09-13. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Built a manual, nonconcurrent installer-staging pipeline selecting exact review patchsets or validated branches, with isolated release/archive outputs and post-installer rehearsal.
Added optional internal MCP packaging through a checkout-owned wrapper while keeping API-sensitive release gates explicit.
Implemented staged API contract binding that preserves reviewed authority and limits native support for drifted operations while retaining controlled-fallback discovery.
This investigation inspected staging and deployment-binding code; no installer build, Jenkins execution, module publication or remote acceptance was performed.

notes: 2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
